diags.message: a value lacking a required property of its declared type is not supported yet
diags.hint: the value is legal JavaScript and Node checks no declared type; the checker names the properties its target type requires. Admitting it needs a differential proof that the lowering is Node-exact — the checker's refusal stands until then (TypeScript reports TS2739 here.)
